name: "Those creatures" / "Each of them" — objects the effect just moved or chose
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. A second sentence whose subject is a demonstrative for objects the sentence before returned, put onto the battlefield or had the player choose produced nothing: Ever After ("Each of those creatures is a black Zombie in addition …"), Hope and Glory ("Each of them gets +1/+1"), Ghost Vacuum ("Each of them is a 1/1 Spirit in addition …"), Nissa, Worldwaker −7 ("Those lands become 4/4 Elemental creatures with trample"), Sigarda's Vanguard and Sigardian Zealot ("choose any number of creatures with different powers. Those creatures gain …"), Rampaging Growth ("Until end of turn, that land becomes …" after a search). _resolveTheyPronoun (cards-text-utils.js) now turns those subjects into a pick of that many permanents of the kind named ("Up to two target creatures each are …", "Any number of target lands become …"); the add-type parser keeps the target count of such a subject, and Sigarda's Vanguard's own-trigger effect is no longer force-pinned to the Vanguard. Tokens the sentence before created are still left alone. Each effect is shown on the permanents picked and not on one left out.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Ever After
scryfallData.oracle_text: Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield. Each of those creatures is a black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types. Put Ever After on the bottom of its owner's library.

scryfallData.name: Silvercoat Lion
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"In the wild, white fur like mine is an aberration. We lack natural camouflage, but the inability to hide encourages other strengths."
—Ajani Goldmane

scryfallData.name: Runeclaw Bear
scryfallData.flavor_text: The magic of the elves leaves its mark on the forest. The magic of the forest leaves its mark on the animals who live there. The animals of the forest leave their mark on all who trespass.

scryfallData.name: Hope and Glory
scryfallData.oracle_text: Untap two target creatures. Each of them gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"Serra ruled by faith. I cannot afford that luxury."
—Radiant, archangel
